top_signals.title: Jefferies Stung by Soured Bets at Asset-Management Unit
top_signals.summary: Jefferies Financial Group's asset-management unit revenue slumped more than 50% in the fiscal third quarter, totaling $85.6 million in the three months through August. Bloomberg Intelligence's Neil Sipes has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Lula e Flávio empatam na reta final, mostra AtlasIntel
top_signals.summary: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva e o senador Flávio Bolsonaro estão empatados com 48% dos votos na reta final da corrida presidencial, segundo nova pesquisa AtlasIntel para a Bloomberg News. Produção de Patricia Xavier e edição de texto de Daniel Carvalho e Andrew Rosati.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Consumer optimism slides sharply as fears escalate over rising prices and jobs
top_signals.summary: The Conference Board's Consumer Confidence Index tumbled to 81.9, a decline of 6.7 points and a reading well below the forecast for 89.
